title: Reflexivity of the kernel of a surjection with reflexive middle term and torsion-free quotient
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that in an exact sequence of finite modules over a Noetherian domain, reflexivity of the middle term together with torsion freeness of the quotient forces reflexivity of the kernel. The proof dualises the sequence twice to obtain a commutative diagram in which the middle vertical arrow is an isomorphism and the right one is injective, reduces to the claim that the map induced on the double duals of the kernel is injective, and then proves that claim: the cokernel Q of the dualised sequence becomes zero after tensoring with the fraction field, because the map on the fraction fields is a split injection of vector spaces, so Q is torsion and has no maps into the ring. A diagram chase then identifies the left vertical arrow as an isomorphism.
